update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.37 - Race data: 4 missing dirt races added
Added ----- - Added 4 dirt races that were missing from the race data: Ladies' Prelude, TCK Jo-o Hai, Tokyo Hai, and Tokyo Sprint (all run at Ooi). These were part of a batch of NAR (regional dirt racing) content that the race data had never been refreshed to include, so the Smart Race Solver had no knowledge of them.
Known limitation ---------------- - These 4 races have a placeholder fan-reward value (0) until a future data refresh fills in the real number. This only affects race scoring when fan-weighted optimization is enabled (off by default). A further batch of newly-added races could not be included yet because they run at brand-new regional tracks not yet named in the data source.
